verdict.rationale: GitCafe's agent features all point to external AI tools: a button hands an issue or pull request to third-party coding agents (Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others), and an MCP server and WebMCP expose tools to outside agents. These are handoff and integration features, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The button next to an issue or pull request number hands it to a coding agent. Its menu lists Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and T3 Code
